article-demo-typical.caption_en: Strict NVIDIA compatibility run of unchanged hello_world.py with a PyPTO artifact and passing golden comparison.
article-demo-typical.caption_zh: 未改写 hello_world.py 的严格 NVIDIA 兼容运行、PyPTO artifact 与 golden 精度通过。

build-release.caption_en: Live four-stage build (wheels/native/CTest/install, all return_code=0, status=complete) executed in Ubuntu entered via `wsl -d Ubuntu` from PowerShell.
build-release.caption_zh: PowerShell 中 wsl -d Ubuntu（紫色终端）真实执行四阶段构建：wheels/native/CTest/install 全部 return_code=0，status=complete。
build-release.command: envs/pypto-release/bin/python tools/build_release.py --stage all --jobs 24 2>&1 | tail -1 | python3 -m json.tool

model-inference.caption_en: Live end-to-end inference: fixed-prompt 64-token greedy decoding with per-token gates and 100% PyPTO coverage.
model-inference.caption_zh: 真实端到端推理：固定 prompt 的 64-token 贪心解码，逐 token 门禁与 100% PyPTO coverage。
model-inference.command: envs/pypto-release/bin/python tools/run_model_correctness.py all --model-path models/Qwen3.5-9B --semantic-oracle runs/semantic-oracle-qwen35-9b-chat-nonthinking.json 2>&1 | tail -1 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('control status:', d['status'], '| runs:', len(d.get('runs',[])))" && python3 tools/print_model_gate_live.py

operator-correctness.caption_en: Live GPU operator correctness regression: 8/8 suites, 101 cases, all_correct=true.
operator-correctness.caption_zh: 真实 GPU 算子正确性回归：8/8 套件、101 用例全部通过（all_correct=true）。
operator-correctness.command: envs/pypto-release/bin/python tools/run_operator_regression.py --stage all 2>&1 | tail -1 | python3 -m json.tool && python3 -c "import json,glob,os; p=sorted(glob.glob('runs/*/operator-numerical-regression.json'),key=os.path.getmtime)[-1]; d=json.load(open(p)); print(); print('newest GPU report:', p); print('status:', d['status'], '| all_correct:', d['all_correct']); [print(s['suite_id'], '| cases:', s['case_count'], '| rc:', s['return_code']) for s in d['suites']]; print('total cases:', sum(s['case_count'] for s in d['suites']))"

operator-performance.caption_en: Live operator-level performance A/B: 7 aligned operators, PyPTO vs SGLang stock, 4+4 fresh starts.
operator-performance.caption_zh: 真实算子级性能 A/B：7 个功能对齐算子，PyPTO vs SGLang stock，4+4 次独立冷启动。
operator-performance.command: envs/pypto-release/bin/python tools/run_operator_performance.py --matrix --model-path models/Qwen3.5-9B 2>&1 | tail -1 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('control status:', d['status'], '| lane starts:', len(d['runs']), '| aggregation:', str(d.get('aggregation','n/a')).split('/')[-2])" && python3 tools/print_operator_ab_table.py

terminal.theme: Ubuntu purple profile, nested PowerShell prompt -> wsl -d Ubuntu
